name: MotionBlock
summary: Blocks GIFs, CSS/JS/SVG animations, parallax and other motion globally or per site so designers can verify a page's reduced-motion state and readability.
browsersNote: No Firefox or Edge listing found on the check date.
license: GPL-3.0 (stated on the store page; GitHub molodchyk/MotionBlock).
goodFor: Checking readability and behavior with GIFs and animations blocked.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: motion block animation gif parallax reduced motion accessibility readability
